name: Discrete Multi-Material Interface Reconstruction
aliases: Discrete Multi-Material Interface Reconstruction — Potts-model Interface Reconstruction, Subcell Labeling for Material Interfaces
Volume Fraction Labeling via Potts Model Optimization
definition: A method to reconstruct material interfaces from volume fraction data by discretizing cells into subcells, labeling them with material IDs, and optimizing the labeling to minimize interface energy while preserving volume fractions.
